title: Tests/scripts leak temp dirs under TMPDIR (verify-dnd5e-srd-pack-*, lw-*, measure-run-*)
description: Observed 2026-09-24 on a dev host with TMPDIR=/dev/shm: ~3,400 stale temp dirs from this repo accumulated and, with ~230 vitest ssr caches, filled the 3.9G tmpfs (ENOSPC broke all agent shell output). Repo-owned leakers: verify:dnd5e-srd-pack (verify-dnd5e-srd-pack-* ~12M each, 21 found), test temp dirs lw-camp-*/lw-sep-*/lw-doltroot-*/lw-rs-*/lw-doltbin-*/lw-emptyhome-*/lw-cp-*/lw-root-*/lw-dolt-*/lw-arc-* (thousands, small), and scripts/measure-run.mjs (measure-run-*, ~200). Fix: remove temp dirs in finally/afterEach/afterAll (mkdtemp + rm -rf), and make verify-dnd5e-srd-pack clean its scratch dir on success and failure. Acceptance: a full npm run verify:worktree plus verify:dnd5e-srd-pack leaves no new entries under TMPDIR.
notes: PR opened from branch eshyra-knh9 (head b92df4e7, integrated from eshyra-knh9.1 after supervisor review + independent verify with isolated TMPDIR: only node-compile-cache + tsx-1000 remain, 7.3M). Stays in_progress until merge.
